system.description:
Thanks to mass-produced designs and sculpted media-star
composite visages, your cookie-cutter looks are so mundane as to be indistinguishable. It is difficult to pick your common-place face out of the crowd, describe its appearance, or otherwise remember physical details. Apply a –10 modifier to tests made to spot, describe, or remember you; this does not apply to psi or mesh searches. 

This trait may not be applied to any morph with an Availability lower than 50.
